text: Besides direct segmentation functions (sg_segment_threshold(), sg_segment_watershed(), sg_segment_propagate() optional Cellpose, StarDist Mesmer wrappers), segmantR provides: Versioned declarative protocols (segmantR-protocol-v1): threshold.otsu.v1, threshold.adaptive.v1, threshold.triangle.v1, watershed.distance.v1, watershed.h_minima.v1, propagate.voronoi.v1, postprocess.label-cleanup.v1 optional stardist.2d.v1, cellpose.2d.v1, mesmer.2d.v1. Parameters whitelisted every run records exact delegate call. neutral interchange format (segmantR-interchange-v1): JSON manifests, exact integer label TIFF, pixel-edge GeoJSON stable object ids, measurement tables explicit special values, SHA-256 inventories. Imports staged; reviewed masks protected. Training datasets model bundles grouped, leakage-free splits, model cards, runtime descriptions checksums. QuPath programs: readable Groovy templates driven run.json Script Editor QuPath script, StarDist parameter adapter. core runs without Python, QuPath EBImage; optional backends checked used. Current capability status: See vignette("protocols--interop", package = "segmantR") system.file("interop", "INTEROP.md", package = "segmantR").
